messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: real a,b,c;
parts:
Hi, Bob. I think I asked about this but can't remember (or find in my emails) the response:
Is it easy to allow multiple declaration statements such as
real a, b, c;
This is no big deal but will make the models look much cleaner. Otherwise we start building up big ugly piles of declaration statements (and, yes, I know we can do "real a; real b; real c;" but I think that looks pretty confusing too.
Thx
A

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] real a,b,c;
parts:
It's on the to-do list. It's not that hard.

I also want to add compound declaration/definition
statements like:

real a <- 10.0;

I did some pre-emptive coding a while back to make
this easier in the future, but it's still going to
take me a few hours I can't seem to find to do it.

I already have vectorization on the stack now that
I did the latest changes to the manual!

I'm not complaining -- just letting you know why this
stuff that seems easy takes forever to get done.

- Bob
